classificationPolicy: Current curated taxonomy; historical financial observations, not a historical investable universe.

description.en: Generation, grids, power distribution, engineering, liquid cooling, thermal management, and data-center real estate are the physical constraint layer for compute expansion.
description.zh: 发电、电网、配电、工程、液冷、热管理和数据中心物业，是算力扩张的物理约束层。

description.en: Wafer-fabrication equipment, process materials, testing, metrology, and chip-design automation tools.

description.en: GPUs, CPUs, custom accelerators, interconnect silicon, and processor IP form the core value-capture layer of AI compute.
description.zh: GPU、CPU、定制加速器、互连芯片和处理器IP，是AI算力的核心价值捕获层。

description.en: Foundry capacity, advanced packaging, HBM/DRAM, NAND, and data storage turn chip designs into deployable hardware.

description.en: AI servers, switches, Ethernet/InfiniBand interconnects, DSPs, and optical modules determine cluster-scaling efficiency.

description.en: Hyperscalers, GPU clouds, hosted compute, and data-center operators convert capex into rentable computing capacity.
description.zh: Hyperscaler、GPU云、托管算力和数据中心运营商，把资本开支转化为可租用算力。

description.en: Office, marketing, automation, healthcare, industrial, and consumer applications are the final monetization and demand-validation layer for AI value.
